size.value: 3.5 × 4.5cm for general/tourist visa applications; the Ministry of Foreign Affairs consular network additionally states 4 × 3cm specifically for student/trainee/researcher and family-reunification visa categories.

background.value: White background (explicitly required for student/trainee/researcher, family-reunification, and diplomatic visa categories); general consular guidance also references white or light-blue.

validity.value: Photos must be recent (taken within the last six months); two identical photos are required.

expression_restriction.value: Face the camera with a neutral expression, without smiling or showing teeth; face must be evenly illuminated on both sides with no shadows, features clearly visible.

expression.en: Face the camera with a neutral expression, without smiling or showing teeth; face must be evenly illuminated on both sides without shadows, features clearly visible.
expression.ko: 카메라를 정면으로 향하고 무표정을 유지하며 미소를 짓거나 치아를 보이지 않을 것; 얼굴 양쪽에 그림자 없이 고르게 조명되어 이목구비가 뚜렷이 보여야 함.
expression.ja: カメラに対して正面を向き、無表情を保ち、微笑んだり歯を見せたりしないこと。顔の両側に影がなく均一に照明され、目鼻立ちがはっきり見えること。

cross_verification.note_en: Source is the Kingdom of Morocco Ministry of Foreign Affairs consular network (diplomatie.ma subdomains, e.g. us.diplomatie.ma, mw.diplomatie.ma — all display 'KINGDOM OF MOROCCO MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS' branding). Direct WebFetch re-verification of these exact pages repeatedly failed with a TLS certificate error on this session's fetch tool; the values above reflect grounded web-search retrieval of that domain's content rather than a literal re-fetched quote, so they are recorded with some caution. Size/background varies by visa subtype per the same source (see 'size'/'background' values); DB's generic 3.5×4.5cm and white align with the general/tourist-visa figures, so no conflict is logged. Morocco does not operate a universal tourist e-visa; most numerous commercial '.com'/'.org' sites calling themselves 'Morocco eVisa' are private visa-processing agencies, not government portals, and were excluded from verified data per the truthfulness gate.
